name: Context Menu
description: Floating right-click context menu singleton. Creates a positioned .ctx-menu div with .ctx-item children and .ctx-sep separators. Supports disabled items. Closes previous open menus before creating new one (static openMenus tracking). Closes on outside click (document-level listener added via setTimeout(0) to avoid immediate self-close). Fires optional onClose callback on removal.

interface.constructor: new ContextMenu(items: ContextMenuItem[], x: number, y: number)

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Remove DOM element, fire onClose, clean up static tracking

properties.name: onClose
properties.description: Optional callback fired on menu removal

lifecycle.destroyed_by: Outside click or item selection fires remove()
